title: What a good client brief contains

slides.headline: The client brief that saves two rounds of revisions
slides.sub: Six answers to get before any work starts.

slides.headline: Ask what success looks like
slides.body: Get one sentence the client would be happy to read in three months. If they cannot write it, the brief is not ready.

slides.headline: Name the one decision maker
slides.body: Feedback from five people is five briefs. Agree who has the final word before the first draft.

slides.headline: A brief is ready when it has

slides.before: We will know it when we see it.
slides.after: The goal is not decided yet. Pause and decide it together.

slides.label: is enough for a brief. If it needs more, the goal is too vague.

slides.headline: Send this to your next new client
